blurb: Guests can explore exhibits featuring mostly flyable planes and guest aircraft throughout the year. The museum houses one of the Midwest's largest aviation libraries and offers educational day-camps, speakers, seminars, and tours for all ages. The venue is also available for corporate and private events such as galas, weddings, and parties.
extraNote: Museum is closed to prepare for its annual gala and for the gala event itself · If 19th Ave is closed due to construction or weather alert, the museum will be closed
